core_obligations: Support replacement: replace X_0 by the scheme-theoretic support of F_0; the support-finite-type lemma guarantees X_i is the support of F_i and X the support of F.
Properness transfer: Z -> X is a universal homeomorphism; X -> Y is proper because Z -> Y is (image-proper-is-proper).
Eventual conclusion: eventually-proper gives X_i -> Y_i proper for some i; the support Z_i is closed in X_i, so Z_i -> Y_i is proper by closed-immersion-proper and composition.
proof_roadmap: Replace by supports at all levels.
Universal homeomorphism transfers properness to X -> Y.
Eventually proper pieces; support is closed; conclude.
difficulty_reason: Support replacement + universal homeomorphism + image-proper-is-proper + eventually-proper + closed-immersion/composition properness: five standard engines in a chain, each step explicit.

compared.difference: The sibling handles morphisms Y -> X (delivered as L30271); this lemma handles scheme-theoretic supports of finite type modules. Different statements.
